Onboarding control tower

B2B onboarding to revenue, as of __AS_OF__. Fictional data. Every figure is calculated in SQL.

This week

Stages that finished on time are counted above but not listed. Derived from dates in the data: a blocker raised and cleared within the week isn't recorded, and earlier forecasts aren't stored.

Trapped revenue, in flight

Days between forecast and target go-live × expected daily revenue, for journeys forecast to go live late.

Table view

Journey timeline

Parallel onboarding tracks for one in-flight journey. The critical path sets the go-live date.

Critical path Other tracks Forecast (after the as-of date) Planned end
Table view

Open stages by SLA status

Open stages per track. At risk means 75% or more of the target used. Shared client-level tracks count once.

Table view

Team load

Open stages per owner, ranked by in progress plus blocked. Not-started stages wait on other tracks.

In progress Blocked Not started
Table view

Revenue ramp after go-live

7-day average revenue as a share of expected daily revenue, by days since go-live. Live journeys reach run-rate at 90%.

Table view

Client touchpoints after sale

Clients by number of post-sale requests. The cap is 3: a warning at 3, a breach above it.

Table view (clients at or over the cap)

Time to second product

Days from first-product go-live to second-product go-live. Forecast for second products still onboarding.

Built by build_dashboard.py from the views in metrics.sql. Source: github.com/hjypksm-boop/onboarding-control-tower.
